answer: A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The jade schedule is applied in vault and wander publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2808 identities would post 3418 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
